key.name: lap-length
key.summary: The length of a work lap in minutes.

key.name: short-break-length
key.summary: The length of a short break in minutes.

key.name: long-break-length
key.summary: The length of a long break in minutes.

key.name: sessions-until-long-break
key.summary: The number of sessions until a long break.

key.name: daily-goal
key.summary: The number of work laps to aim for per day.

key.name: laps-today
key.summary: Work laps completed on the day stored in laps-date.

key.name: laps-date
key.summary: The date (YYYY-MM-DD) that laps-today refers to.

key.name: fullscreen-break
key.summary: Whether the window should fullscreen during breaks.

key.name: rain-background
key.summary: Whether to show animated raindrops on glass behind the timer.

key.name: rain-image
key.summary: Path to the image seen through the rain. Empty means the built-in image.

key.name: rain-sound
key.summary: Whether the rain sound is audible. It loops, muted otherwise, for as long as the window is open.

key.name: rain-sound-file
key.summary: Path to the audio file played as the rain sound. Empty means no rain sound.

key.name: rain-volume
key.summary: The volume of the rain sound in percent.
